caseName: Daily Pantagraph, Inc. v. United States
caseNameFull: Daily Pantagraph, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Arnold L. Guesmer for petitioner. Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Rugg, and Messrs. Claude R. Branch and Joseph H. Sheppard for the United States.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Claims granted, limited to the question of the reduction of invested capital by reason of dividends paid, being the third question presented in the petition for the writ.
